Use explicit constraint-child evidence with unique recovery_unit_id identities and split certificates. Aggregate all PASS leaves back into one synthesized canonical parent proof only after recursive exact-cover verification. Add same-HEAD automatic controller-generation dispatch from Project Governance after artifacts are persisted; no AI-authored recovery commit is allowed for routine timeout recovery. Preserve Product Master, Formal Runtime, Runtime Adapter, UI business rules, canonical mapping, Human Approval, Release Scope, main and Production as read-only. Do not weaken coverage, identity, artifact integrity, exact-head binding, timeout/error classification, Human Review, or final release gates. Migration must restore the frozen canonical parent population rather than adopting the temporary expanded 7,780 plan as the denominator.
